lines.en: I hop forward, one jump at a time.
Every landing shakes the ground.
The ice spikes on me quiver.

lines.zh: 雪地被我压出一个个坑。
lines.en: The snow takes a pit with each landing.

lines.zh: 跳的时候我能看见前面。
lines.en: When I hop, I can see ahead.

lines.zh: 落下来就什么也看不见。
lines.en: Landing, I see nothing.
The ground is cold; I like it.
I hop along slowly.
The snow here has never melted.
White frost clings to my spikes.
I hop over a crack.

lines.zh: 我再跳两下，冰碴跟着响。
lines.en: Two more hops and the ice chips rattle.
When I tire, I rest a while.
I do not know what tired is.
I squelch forward a stretch.
A wet mark stays behind.
I sit still and wobble slowly.
Frost grows on the spikes.
It is colder here than a moment ago.
I am slowly freezing inside.
That is no bad thing.
Snow settles on me.

lines.zh: 雪落在我身上，结成了壳。
lines.en: Snow lands on me and freezes into a shell.
I wobble and shake it off.
The trees beyond are white.
The snow has stopped a while.

lines.zh: 我身上最冷的那根刺先响。
lines.en: The coldest spike on me cracks first.
It splits, then seals again.
You are not dressed warmly enough.
Standing here will freeze you stiff.

lines.zh: 我身上的冰比你的手冷。
lines.en: The ice on me is colder than your hands.
Best not to touch me.
Your breath turns white.
I cannot breathe out mist.
Your boots are on the ice.
You keep slipping.
You are leaning by a stone.
That stone is frosted too.
One of my spikes has broken off.
The break freezes over quickly.
The crack freezes over and I'm hard again.
A puddle stays on the snow.
I slowly swell back.

lines.zh: 冰刺歪了，我的边冻得发脆。
lines.en: My ice spikes bent and my rim froze brittle.
A corner of my edge is missing.
Snow fills the gap.
I sink a little into the snow.
That shields what is inside.
That thing in your hand.
I cannot get it down.
My mouth is only a slit.
You hold it up; I cannot reach.
I have no hands at all.
You set it on the snow.
Now I can reach it even less.
That thing in your hand is warm.

lines.zh: 那东西太热，我碰了会化。
lines.en: That thing's too warm—touching it would melt me.
Do you want me to come over?
Touch me and the spikes go in.
That was not my intent.
But it is not unfair either.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩进我里面一点。
lines.en: Your foot sank into me a little.
The cold climbs up from there.
It takes effort to pull free.
You walk a few steps and slip again.
The ice holds me in place.
Your little finger met a spike.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候滑了一下。
lines.en: You slipped as you moved back.

lines.zh: 我一跳，冰面又裂开一道。
lines.en: I hop once and the ice cracks again.
Ice forms along that path.
Your heels give out first.
You walked a circuit of the ice.
I am made of gel.
Such things have no sexes.
The question makes no sense.

lines.zh: 我连自己是怎么来的都不知道。
lines.en: I do not even know how I came to be.
I cannot answer that question.
We simply grow.
We make no distinction.

lines.zh: 这雪原没有同类，只有我。
lines.en: No kin on this snowfield—only me.

lines.zh: 我们唯一的想法是变大。
lines.en: Our only thought is to grow.
We do not go looking for one another.
Something is frozen on the ground.
I roll over it.
It freezes at once.
Then it stays here.
It is stuck beneath the snow.
I freeze it where it lies.
Nobody will pick it up now.
I do not know what it is.
It is frozen here now.
Nobody will get it later either.
You stand on the ice.
Your feet are slipping.
I hop toward you.
One hop and I am there.

lines.zh: 我先跳一下，冰面替我开路。
lines.en: I hop once and the ice clears the way.
You heard that sound.
That sound will not stop.
Two hops and I am on you.
I hop, tipping myself forward.
You are right where I land.
I close in, hop by hop.
The ice scatters your footing.
Ice spikes all over me. Do not press close.
You cannot run on ice.
My spikes rasp against the ice.
You cannot tell the direction.

lines.zh: 冰面很宽，你没有地方躲。
lines.en: The ice is wide and you have nowhere to hide.
Half my spikes are raised.
You hear the ice crack.
That is me moving.

lines.zh: 冰刺全张，我整个压上去。
lines.en: Spikes out, I press down with everything.
The spikes go in first.
Then the cold.

lines.zh: 我身上的尖刺，是冻出来的。
lines.en: These spikes on me grew from frost.

lines.zh: 我整块压上去，冰刺先扎。
lines.en: I slam down whole, ice spikes hitting first.
One spike stays on your hem.
The cold has taken your hands.
You are pushed backward.
My spikes scrape your armor.
They leave a white line.
A lump rises on the snowfield.
I squeeze out of it.
Ice crust still clings to me.
Nobody has trodden here.
Let me look around.

lines.zh: 我的冰刺一根根立起来。
lines.en: My spikes rise one by one.
A thin sheet of ice seals the ground.
I squeeze out of an ice crack.
Something moves under the ice.
It is me, moving beneath the ice.
Fire roasts me and I melt by degrees.

lines.zh: 我从冰坡上滚下去，碎了一块。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and a piece breaks off.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，水里全是碎冰。
lines.en: I sink, and the water fills with crushed ice.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的一部分吹散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters part of me.

lines.zh: 一根尖物穿过我，留下一个洞。
lines.en: Something pierces me and leaves a hole.

lines.zh: 那光让我的冰一下软了。
lines.en: That light softens my ice at once.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候会变小一些。
lines.en: When hungry, I shrink a little.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的刺全炸开。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and every spike bursts.
The ice beneath me is gone.
